does: The weighted decision of a roll against a difficulty: when the stream owes a success, forces the wanted outcome with a chance that grows with the success debt and lowers that debt; otherwise, when it owes a failure, forces the opposite outcome by the fail debt; reports whether it forced.

evidence.says: The success debt at the stream's +0x64 and the fail debt at +0x60 are each divided by a range looked up by the stream's type, compared with one uniform draw from the stream, and reduced by a multiple of the chance when used

With weighted rolls on, a stream's success debt rose by the chance of each failed attack roll, and a later roll came with its outcome decided before any die of its formula was drawn while the debt fell below zero; a debt of 0.2 did not force the next roll
The success debt at the stream's +0x64 is divided by a range looked up by the stream's type and compared with one uniform draw

questions.ask: A roll on a weighted stream with weighted rolls on and a debt above zero: a watch on the stream's debts shows the write from here
